clip_texts: SC-17 Loss of Autoware while driving

Autoware's commands stop, freeze or become implausible while driving in lane; other road users then pass the vehicle
stopped in lane

One concrete scenario (seeded sample of the logical
scenario)
ODD-20 Ego speed: 2.3 km/h (range 0 to 48 km/h)

Ego slows at 3 m/s², the firm level of FSR-03.02 (DQ-019, DQ-033);
choreography, not Autoware's planned braking

SG-07 (ASIL D): Reach a minimal risk condition whenever the item
can no longer drive safely

The monitor detects the loss within its detection budget and stops
the vehicle in lane with hazard lights on, without Autoware; a
fault of the monitor itself leads to the vehicle's own stop, never
to the park brake while moving (FSR-07.01, FSR-07.02, FSR-07.06,
FSR-07.07, FSR-01.01, FSR-02.02, FSR-04.01, TR-01, SR-01, SR-04)
Autoware's planned path (EL-01 Autoware computer, rated QM)
Safety monitor's envelope (EL-02, ASIL D); length not computed: the vehicle is not chosen yet (DQ-008)
Meant to do: the monitor stops it in lane
Dashed green: the path the pass criterion asks of the vehicle; green ring: where it is judged
Where the hazard lies: HE-07.1 After a fault in planning or control, keeps driving without control instead of stopping
QUALITATIVE ILLUSTRATION · NOT A SIMULATION RESULT · DRAFT FOR ENGINEERING REVIEW
